## 🤔 Context

## Type of change

- [ ] 💡 New project idea
- [ ] 📝 Content fix (link, error, clarity, typo)
- [ ] 🌐 Translation (EN ↔ PT-BR)
- [ ] ✨ Enhancement to an existing brief or track page
- [ ] 🔧 Tooling / CI / repo structure
- [ ] 📚 Docs (README, CONTRIBUTING, etc.)

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are scoped to a single theme.
- [ ] New/edited project briefs stay **guided exercises** — no full, copy-paste solutions.
- [ ] Every relative link I added points to a file/folder that exists.
- [ ] If I touched a bilingual doc, I updated **both** the EN and PT-BR versions (or noted why not).
- [ ] Markdown renders correctly (headings, tables, code fences).
